title: Armatron-80
description: Steer a 3-D robot arm to a target, or press Space and let it reach by itself. New in 2026.
versionOrder: One version, written in 2026. Not a recovered tape.

versions.label: ARMATRON-80
versions.note: New Level II BASIC written in 2026, not recovered from tape. ARMATRON.ASC is the source; npm run build:armatron tokenizes it into ARMATRON.BAS.

attribution.text: A 2026 port of the Armatron demo from Linkage Blaze and the Excel 3-D robot arm, modeling Radio Shack's Armatron toy.
